title: feat(app-shell,plugin-kanban): a card on a kanban view leaf's Studio canvas selects the board's card in a 看板卡片 section (objectui#12725, part)
body:
Part of #12725
Clause-②: no
This lands the release's remainder item 1: a kanban view leaf's card. Still on #12725: item 3's 草稿 chip and 来源 line, which need the copilot's draft provenance per field, and items 4 and 5 (change card v2, the 变更 badge counting the copilot's drafts), which need objectstack-ai/cloud#2924's payload.

## What changed

On an `object` leaf whose list view renders as a kanban board (`type: 'kanban'`), a click on a card in the Studio canvas selects "the card":

- the right slot switches to 属性 and shows the new 看板卡片 section, marked selected; the copilot folds to its strip at the slot's foot;
- the clicked card is outlined;
- the status line reads 「已选中：看板卡片 · Esc 取消选中」.

The click is taken in the capture phase, so the record does not open. The pointer press on a card is taken there too, so the board's drag sensor never starts a move on the Studio canvas. Enter, and Space on its release, on a focused card select it the same way (see objectui#12888 below). A button or link drawn inside a card keeps its click and its keys. Esc, or a click on empty canvas, clears the selection, and the slot keeps the view's properties. Outside Studio the board is unchanged: a click opens the record and a drag moves the card.

- `studio-canvas-preview.tsx`: a Studio-internal `StudioCanvasCardSelectionContext` beside the published props, in the pattern of phase 3's `StudioCanvasColumnSelectionContext`. The default object canvas wraps the grid in one more `display: contents` element (`KanbanCardSelect`) that reads it. `StudioCanvasPreviewProps` and `index.ts` are unchanged, and a canvas registered over the default sees no channel.
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the card is a member of the pillar's one keyed selection, `{ kind: 'card', id: RECORD_ID }`, beside phase 3's `{ kind: 'column' }`, not a second, parallel state. So `showProps`, Esc and the empty-canvas click are the existing seam. The channel is provided only while the panel holds a kanban view of the open leaf.
- `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`: the 看板卡片 section, shown only when the view's `type` is `kanban`, first in the panel, writing through the inspector's existing draft path.
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: 17 en and zh rows. No `@object-ui/i18n` key.

## How a card is identified, and plugin-kanban

`SortableCard` gains ONE additive attribute, `data-kanban-card` set to the card's record id; nothing else in `plugin-kanban` changes, so objectui#12838's `aria-label` work in the same file stays clear. objectui#12888 (merged into this branch) split the card into a `role="listitem"` wrapping a `role="button"` control that holds the ref, the drag listeners, the click and the new Enter and Space handlers; the attribute sits on that control, so `closest('[data-kanban-card]')` and the outline rule each resolve to exactly one element per card. Because #12888 opens a focused card on Enter and on Space's release, the canvas takes those keys in the capture phase too, only on the card element itself (#12888's own guard): Enter and Space's release select the card, Space's press is held so the board does not scroll, and neither reaches the card's handlers. Outside Studio the keys open the record, as #12888 made them. Measured why the existing DOM was not enough: `role="listitem"` alone does find a card (the board draws no other list item), but the outline has to name the clicked card, and `aria-label` is the card's title, which is record text that two cards can share (and a translated or derived title besides). A style rule keyed on it would outline every card of that title. The record id names exactly one card.

The outline is a style rule scoped to the wrapper, as phase 3's column outline is: the board owns its cards and redraws them, so no class can be put on a card from outside.

## The four controls

Each writes one key the spec declares, and only that key (`@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.3`, unchanged from next.2 for these keys):

| control | key written | spec line it rests on |
|---|---|---|
| 卡片字段 (card fields), ordered | `kanban.columns` | `KanbanConfigSchema.columns`: "Fields to show on cards" |
| 标题 (title) | `kanban.titleField`; 记录名称 removes the key | `KanbanConfigSchema.titleField`: "Omit to fall back to the record display name (ADR-0079 resolver chain)" |
| 点击打开 (click to open) | `navigation.mode`; 默认 removes the key (and an empty `navigation` block with it) | `NavigationConfigSchema.mode` over `NavigationModeSchema`: page, drawer, modal, split, popover, new_window, none |
| 分组字段 (group by) | `kanban.groupByField` | `KanbanConfigSchema.groupByField` "Field to group columns by", checked by `groupByFieldCheck`, which refuses only a padded name; every field of the object is offered |

`KanbanConfigSchema` is a strict object that requires `groupByField` and `columns`. So on a kanban view with no `kanban` block, the title and the card fields are disabled with a note until a group-by field is picked, and picking it writes `{ groupByField, columns: [] }`; on an empty `kanban.columns` the board shows the view's first columns, as before. No colour control (`rowColor` has no reader in `plugin-kanban`), and no `summarizeField` control (the StudioRailProps artboard draws none); an existing `summarizeField` is kept as written.

## Live, before and after

`e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` (published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.3`, showcase `2c9bf9430a11`), console from `main` `26323c4` (before) and this branch `9591cd2` (after), Chromium, light, zh-CN, 1280 and 1010 px. Leaf: 界面 › 数据模型 › 任务看板（看板视图）, the showcase's own `board` kanban view of `showcase_task`.

- Before: a card click opens the record-detail overlay (「Showcase task详情」), the slot stays on the copilot, nothing is selected. The status line already says 「点元素 → 右栏切到属性」 there, and nothing answers it.
- After: the slot switches to 属性 with 看板卡片 selected, the card is outlined, the status line names it, no overlay opens and the URL does not change. Esc and an empty-canvas click clear it; the slot stays on 属性.

## Deviations

- The showcase declares kanban list views (`task.view.ts` `board`, `project.view.ts` `by_status`), but no `object` nav entry of the showcase lands on one, so there is no kanban view leaf to open (phase 3 measured the same). The live reading adds one entry in the browser, `{ type: 'object', objectName: 'showcase_task', viewName: 'board' }`, identically for before and after. The README beside the screenshots lists every stub.
- `plugin-kanban` is touched by the one attribute above, as ruling 3 allows when the existing DOM cannot identify a card.

## Acceptance notes

- Keyboard activation selects a card too: since objectui#12888 a focused card opens on Enter and Space, so on the Studio canvas those keys select it, as a click does.
- While a card keeps keyboard focus, the browser's focus ring on its control draws over the selection outline (`after-1280-card-enter.png`).
- At 1010 px the item header's title is drawn with no visible text beside its chips, on `main` and on this branch alike (`before-1010-open.png`).

## Test evidence (head `9bce2a9`; the suites ran on `14078da`, and `9bce2a9` changes only the changeset's prose)

- New: `StudioDesignSurface.kanbanCardSelection-12725.test.tsx`, 16 tests through the mounted surface with the real `StudioObjectRecordsCanvas` and the real kanban board: the card click (slot 属性, section selected, outline, status line, no record opened, the press never reaches the card); Enter on a focused card selects it; Space selects on its release, and neither half reaches the card's own handlers; a control inside a card keeps its click and its keys; Esc; empty canvas; each control writes exactly its key and the saved body parses as `ListViewSchema`; a view with no `kanban` block. Controls: a grid leaf has no section; the board outside Studio opens the record on a click and on Enter, and takes the press; a canvas registered over the default gets no channel.
- Every `StudioDesignSurface*`, `studioCanvas*` / `studio-canvas-preview` and `ObjectListViewInspector*` test: 97 files, 671 tests passed. `packages/plugin-kanban/` (objectui#12888's tests included): 75 files, 506 tests passed. Phase 3's `leafColumnSelection-12725` is in the family run, unchanged and green.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`: exit 0. `build` for both: exit 0. `eslint` (normal mode) on the changed files: 0 errors, and the diff adds no `eslint-disable` directive; the new warnings are `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the new exports, the rule already firing in both files.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:test-path-roots`, `check-changeset-presence`: all exit 0.
- Ablation, one mutant per new pin, through objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (each restore proven with an empty `git diff HEAD`): the card select off, the click's stopPropagation off, the press capture off, the outline naming another card, the control exemption off, `data-kanban-card` removed, the channel not provided, Esc off, empty-canvas clear off, `showProps` off, the section on every view, the section not marked selected, each of the four writes broken, the record-name option keeping the title, a born block without `columns`, the title not held for the block; after objectui#12888, Enter not taken, Space's release not taken, Space's press not held, the own-key guard widened to anything inside a card, the key path not stopped, and the attribute removed again: each turned at least one test red. Not pinned, by measurement: the channel's kanban gate (no cards exist on a non-kanban canvas to tell it apart).
